items.text: Took the time to learn the game, put some hours in, waited for 1.0, I think it got worse.  I have no idea where to go anymore.  I was hopeful they would fill out oklg station with cool apartments or places to go but no, just marked out places.  Often, the game feels openly hostile to the player. I got a 15000 dollar fine for an automatic action by my character of stamping out a cigarette butt on a space station.  If you just leave the butt there no problem.  If you let the character automatically stamp it out you get arrested.
items.text_zh: 花时间学习了这款游戏，投入了一些时间，等待1.0版本，我觉得它变得更糟了。我不知道该去哪里了。我曾希望他们会用很酷的公寓或可去的地方来充实oklg空间站，但没有，只是标记出来的地方。游戏常常感觉对玩家公开充满敌意。我因为角色在空间站上自动踩灭烟头的行为被罚款15000美元。如果你就把烟头留在那里，没问题。如果你让角色自动踩灭它，你就会被逮捕。
